articles.description: Cincinnati Reds closer Emilio Pagán declined a $10 million option for 2027 to enter free agency. Neither Pagán nor the Reds has ruled out a reunion.
articles.title: Cincinnati Reds closer Emilio Pagán free agent after declining option

articles.description: Cincinnati closer Emilio Pagán (19-for-19 in save chances, 1.88 ERA after a hamstring injury) is one of 3 Reds with contract decisions due Oct. 31.
articles.title: Why an Emilio Pagán decision is key to Cincinnati Reds' playoff future
